_doc: One rule, one owner. Registered by the CEO's context-architecture order of 2026-07-30, after the measured finding that the same rule lived in dozens of files and the copies had drifted — which is how a rule he had given ('speak to me in my language') sat in a complaint ledger for nine days while binding nobody. Each entry names a sentence that belongs to exactly ONE file. ledger-truth.mjs fails the battery when a registered fingerprint appears anywhere else in the ACTIVE instruction surfaces.
_scope: Active instruction only: .claude/CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills/**/SKILL.md, .claude/hooks/*.sh, and the corpus's law and spec files. Deliberately EXCLUDED, each for a stated reason: 00-INDEX.md (the registered-adaptation table is a DATED RECORD of what was decided on a day, not active instruction — rewriting it would be rewriting history), 00-NOTE-* (dated session notes, same reason), .planning/STATE-ARCHIVE.md (frozen), docs/ceo-directives/** (the CEO's own documents — we never annotate or edit what he wrote), references/** (his evidence).
_how_to_use: Naming a rule is always allowed — 'see RULE #0-A' is a pointer. What is forbidden is restating its TEXT in a second file. A fingerprint must therefore be a phrase from the rule's body, and it must fit on ONE line: these files are hard-wrapped, so a phrase that spans a line break silently matches nothing (measured while building this, 2026-07-30).
_growing: This registry does not claim to cover every rule in the corpus. It covers the rules that were relocated on 2026-07-30 plus the laws most likely to be re-copied. Entries are added as rules are consolidated; an unregistered rule is simply unguarded, never blessed.

so13_full_capacity.fingerprint: USE FULL CAPACITY ON EVERY TURN
so13_full_capacity.what: Standing order 13 — the nine forms of laziness. Re-injected on every prompt, which is why the hook owns it: a second copy in the always-on file paid for the same text twice.

so14_boundary.fingerprint: THE CEO IS THE OWNER, NOT A DEVELOPER
so14_boundary.what: Standing order 14, the BOUNDARY — the banned vocabulary and the self-test. A hook and not a skill because it governs every sentence he reads, not a particular job: on 2026-07-30 it was placed in a skill and was violated within the hour, because a rule that binds only when the author opens a door does not bind.

so14_report_shape.what: Standing order 14, the PROCEDURE — what a message to the CEO must contain, and how far the rule reaches across the system's own surfaces.

evidence_unverified_label.what: Evidence-before-done — the label that separates what a terminal proved from what it cannot.

rule0a_sources.what: RULE #0-A clause 2 — a grep hit tells you where to read, not what is true.

rule0a_danger.what: RULE #0-A opening — the CEO's own framing of what guessing costs this project.

rule0b_ceiling.what: RULE #0-B — the spec is the floor, the perfection gate is the ceiling.

rule0_design_pass.what: RULE #0 — the operational design-verification pass. The CEO's directive owns the LAW; this door owns the PROCEDURE.

board_law_one_row.what: The board's first law. The board owns its own laws; the closing door points at them.

so11_process_skill_first.fingerprint: The process skill comes before the work
so11_process_skill_first.what: Standing order 11 — the matching process skill is invoked before the work, and subagents never author. Registered after this rule was found to have lost its home during the 2026-07-30 consolidation: it existed in a complaint ledger and in nothing a session reads.

onboarding_read_order.what: The onboarding principle — read the smallest set that lets you act correctly.

first_reply_states_position.fingerprint: YOUR FIRST REPLY IN A SESSION STATES THE POSITION
first_reply_states_position.what: A session's first reply tells the CEO where the work stands before answering him. Written after a fresh session answered his greeting with 'what would you like me to do?' — the babysitting this product exists to end.

authority_order.what: The authority order. Its absence was the measured cause of two documents contradicting each other with nothing to settle it.

law_a_delete.what: LAW A (CEO, 2026-07-30) — a live order deletes the record it overturns.

law_b_accepted.what: LAW B (CEO, 2026-07-30) — only his own eye accepts.
